text:
Kod vas dolazim bezbrizno, jer znam da sam u sigurnim rukama.
Uvijek topla preporuka je ordinacija " Lopicic" za profesionalan tim sa visokim vjestinama, a i izlaskom iz iste sa najljepsim osmjesima.
Ljubazni, prijatni, profesionalni! Odlazak kod zubara bez straha! 🙂
The best dental clinic I've ever been to! Professional and friendly staff, high-quality service. I was satisfied with all the things I did there. I would highly recommend it to everyone!
Najbolja stomatološka ordinacija u Podgorici. Cjelokupno osoblje je jako ljubazno i prijatno. Doktori strucni i posveceni svakom pacijentu. Odlican odnos cijene i kvaliteta. Sve preporuke!
Doktorica Anđela je za svaku preporuku!!!
Izuzetan tim na čelu sa doktorom Aleksandrom,jako ljubazno osoblje. Sve preporuke.
Beste Praxis in Montenegro ❤️❤️❤️
Toliko strucnosti, pedantnosti i posvecenosti svom poslu, odavno nisam vidjela. Odusevljena sam vasim radom i krajnjim rezultatom. Najiskrenija preporuka za dr Lopicica i njegov tim.

I’m more than satisfied with dr Lopicic and his team. He saved my tooth for which I was sure was lost. He was always ready to help and work long hours as the procedure required several visits. Another time I went there for tooth extraction. It was just before the state holiday when other doctors didn’t dare to take such a responsibility. He did it so remarkably well that the day after I didn’t have any pain, and I have to add that procedure was quite complicated. However, he did it with ease. Not only professional, but always friendly and in bright mood.
Savršen kolektiv, veoma prijatan i stručan.
Superb dental services! The team here exudes warmth and professionalism, making every visit comfortable. They always do an excellent job and I recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable dentist.
staff is not qualified.  appointment  time not respected
I had teeth polishing and cavities treatment here. Thanks to Dr Amra A., all went well!

I had an amazing experience today when I brought my younger son for a visit.  The doctors and the staff were friendly, professional and, most importantly, very patient with my son who was very scared when he first arrived.

I highly recommend them to everyone and will definitely always go here if/when we need dental services while back in Montenegro.
Thank you!

Predivno iskustvo danas sa mladjim sinom koji je bio vrlo uplasen.  Preporucujem!

Exceptional professional. He saved my honeymoon and did an espetacular job, doing the new restauration much away better than the one has gone. Unfortunately I don’t live in Podgorica to do all my dental needs with him.

Uradio sam na svim zubima: metalo keramicke i bezmetalne krunice. Kvalitetno i strucno odradjeno,  bolje ne moze. Svi koji su mi videli zube, odusevili su se. Dobio sam holivudski osmeh. Ovim putem im se zahvaljujem.. Sve preporuke!
Changed 5 doctors before I got to him, he saved me, did excelent job in one day. I was amazed. Higly recomend to others. Best doctor, best service
Stručno osoblje,kvalitetan materijal i odličan pristup pacijentu.Dr Aleksandar Lopičic odličan stomatolog.Sve preporuke
Did a great job, so glad I visited! Nice office and staff, western standards, came highly recommended.
to je bog kako radi!
